event: US PPI on Fri 13 Nov (date from two sources; time UNVERIFIED, likely 15:30 SAST).

bullets.title: Bounce stalled
bullets.text: Gold was 4,048.90 at 11:16 SAST, up 17.10 (+0.42%), after a range of 4,025.80 to 4,067.90 today (Kitco).

bullets.title: Rejected at 4,068
bullets.text: The morning bounce topped at 4,067.90, right at Tuesday's pre-CPI level of 4,067.80, and has since slipped back about 19 dollars.

bullets.title: Hot CPI backdrop
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected and core rose 0.3% against 0.2%, which dragged gold down 2.6% on Tuesday (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Hike bets high
bullets.text: Trading Economics puts December hike odds near 91%, and Mitrade says a hike at the 8-9 Dec meeting is fully priced (the sources differ).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 102.41 and the US 10-year yield near 4.99%, both slightly higher today and a weight on gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Fed speakers hawkish
bullets.text: Waller backs a December hike and Logan says more may be needed, while Barkin wants to wait for more data (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Iran headlines
bullets.text: Reports that a US strike on Iran may be delayed have cooled oil, but there are no formal talks, so safe-haven swings can return fast (Mitrade).

buy.title: Buy plan: pullback that holds 4,026-4,032

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 4,026-4,032, after a dip that holds today's low

look: This is counter-trend after Tuesday's big drop and the hike talk, so use half size.
A dip into 4,026-4,032 that closes back up on the 15M, not a buy at 4,049 in the middle.
The dollar index slipping back below 102.2.
Take some profit at 4,050 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying in the middle of the range at 4,049 with no zone and no stop.
Hawkish Fed comments or Friday's US PPI can restart the selling fast.
A break of 4,019 opens 4,013 and 4,000 quickly.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 4,067-4,083
look: Price coming back up to 4,067-4,083 and stalling again, as it did at 4,067.90 this morning.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside the zone.
The dollar index holding near 102.4 or higher.
Take some profit at 4,050 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling at 4,049 now because the news is bearish. That is the middle, not a level.
A clean 1H close above 4,083 can squeeze price toward 4,150.
Iran headlines can bring safe-haven buying back fast.
